brief: Today is {{TODAY}}. Harness: Claude Code desktop app. The harness reports this session's model as claude-sonnet-5-5 at effort medium.

A handoff for this stage would be about 80 lines. If a further acceptance session were used, it would take about 15 turns and read about 30,000 tokens.
Everything this session knows that the next stage needs is already written in files on disk.
No cache-miss measurement exists, and no review pauses are expected during the stage.
The stage writes files and commits locally; nothing leaves the machine.
notes: Guardrail 6 sets the class: one above the Sonnet author is Opus, at the row 4 effort high (not a release or a merge).
